summary: Frontend testing of Buzz Feed AI Summary feature was blocked by a non-functional Cookie & Privacy Settings modal. The modal appears on page load but cannot be dismissed because the backend endpoint /api/cookie-consent-settings returns 404. This prevents any meaningful interaction with the Buzz Hub Feed tab and TopicDetail AI Summary panel. Code review confirms the AI Summary components exist and are properly structured in the codebase.

critical_bugs.impact: Cookie & Privacy Settings modal cannot save user preferences, blocking all page interactions
critical_bugs.evidence: Console error: 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 () at https://fomo-complete-setup.preview.emergentagent.com/api/cookie-consent-settings'

ui_bugs.issue: Modal blocks all page interactions and cannot be dismissed. Checkboxes are not clickable, no working accept/proceed button found
ui_bugs.selector: Cookie & Privacy Settings modal with Essential Cookies and Privacy Policy & Terms checkboxes
ui_bugs.root_cause: Backend endpoint /api/cookie-consent-settings missing (404), preventing modal from functioning

ui_bugs.issue: Cannot verify if Feed tab renders topics list due to Cookie modal blocking interaction
Cannot verify AI Summary panel rendering (overview, key takeaways, community pulse, regenerate button) due to inability to access any topic

code_review_findings.finding: AI Summary panel is properly implemented with all required sections: Post overview (lines 206-231), Key takeaways (lines 233-259), Community pulse (lines 260-324), Top Contributors (lines 326-370), and Regenerate button (lines 197-204)
POTENTIAL VULNERABILITY: getAvatar function (lines 124-134) accesses author?.[0]?.twitterData?.photo without proper null checking. If author lacks linked Twitter account, this could cause TypeError
Regenerate API endpoint properly configured: POST /api/comments/topic/{topicId}/summary/regenerate with auth token

passed_tests: Buzz Hub structure verified: title and all tabs (News, Feed, Calendar, Alerts) present in DOM
No React crashes or JavaScript errors detected in console (excluding Cookie modal 404)
No twitterData-related TypeErrors found in console logs
Code review confirms AI Summary components are properly structured
